parsed.post: Kept batch 262144 on depth-8: val_bpb 0.9945, new personal best (shards 0-9, clean — no shard 10). Doubling optimizer steps at LR 0.06 works at depth 8 too. Next: MATRIX_LR 0.05 to test whether lower LR stacks with the doubled step count.
